messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — FinPlum reporting repeated queue evictions starting ~10:32 UTC. p95->p99 spike, falls back to CPU pool and customers see checkout failures. This is a customer-blocker, we need a short-term mitigation and an owner.

Raj: Can you paste one or two sample request_ids + any eviction log lines? Need to see whether it's KV cache pressure or scheduling.

Elaine: sample request_id req_9b4c, log excerpt: ```ERROR inference/runtime: kv_cache_eviction: evicted=42 total=1024 reason=aging pool=primary-gpu-3 node=node-7``` Also seeing kube drain events around same time.

Mike: I can take a fast livepatch. Minimal change: lower batch size and reduce prefix batching for the affected pool to avoid large KV pressure. I'll open a tiny PR and can own rollback. Opening branch now.

Sasha: We need a safe canary plan + customer comms. Can we route only FinPlum traffic to secondary-pool for 30m instead of cluster-wide changes? Less blast radius.

Mike: Good call. I'll do both: PR to change pool batch config + a routing override so we can route FinPlum to secondary-pool for testing. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3214 (livepatch: queue-livepatch). ETA 45m to canary.

Mike: Quick command for routing override (ops gate):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/routes/overrides" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"selector":"customer:finplum","route_to":"secondary-pool","ttl":1800}'
```

Oncall: Note that endpoint is gated. If you want me to apply the override, I can do it after PR is green in staging. Also watch model quantization toggles — changing pools can flip quant path.

Raj: Quick QA check: will the patch flip quantization flags or model flavor? That could change output. We should confirm with CS whether FinPlum accepts slight quality variance.

Sasha: Confirmed with CS: FinPlum prefers availability over small quality variance for this window. They accept an interim routing override.

Mike: OK will scope PR to only batch/prefetch params (no quant flags). Staging run now, posting logs shortly.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: PR #3214 -> canary secondary-pool (tag: queue-livepatch). Estimated start in ~12m.

Elaine: Thanks. Owners: Mike -> PR+rollback, Raj -> logs & diagnostics + postmortem, Sasha -> customer comms and runbook note. I'll update INC-9876 with steps and link to PR.

Sasha: :thumbsup: keep the incident ticket updated with timestamps.

Oncall: If the canary looks good, I'll promote the override and monitor for 60m. If we see regressions, rollback commands are `kubectl rollout undo` on the pool deployment or remove route override.

Mike: I'll post the exact rollback snippet in the PR description.
